name: Chicken tikka bowl
steps: Mix greek yogurt with garlic, ginger, garam masala, cumin and chilli powder.
Coat the diced chicken breast and let it sit 15 minutes.
Grill or pan-sear the chicken until charred and cooked through, about 12 minutes.
Warm the rice, pile in a bowl and add the chicken.
Squeeze lemon over and scatter fresh coriander.
